_doc: Reference FPS animation packs, and how to read each one. tools/extract_ref_pack.py turns a pack into weapon-space JSON that tools/retarget_ref_anim.py transfers onto our rigs. Until 2026-07-28 the only extracted pack lived in a session scratchpad under AppData/Local/Temp, so the entire viewmodel pipeline depended on a directory Windows is free to delete; this file exists so any pack can be rebuilt from its source archive.
_root_doc: Sources are relative to `root`. Override with the RECON_REF_PACKS environment variable. The packs are the Summoner's own downloads and are NOT redistributed in this repo - only the extracted motion JSON is.
_map_doc: `map` binds canonical keys to this pack's own rig. Prefix `bone:` for an armature bone, `obj:` for an object - packs differ on whether the weapon's moving parts are bones (BoltActionRifle, Benelli, MP5) or separate objects (sawnoff). Canonical keys: W_Grip (the weapon frame everything is measured against, required), hand_L/hand_R/elbow_L/elbow_R (required), W_Magazine (the detachable feed device), W_bolt (the part the support hand cycles), W_hinge (a break-action barrel), W_shell (a single loose round), W_release (a catch or lever).
_license_doc: Every pack below is CC-Attribution except where noted; a credit line is owed in the shipped game. m4a1-s-cs2 is CC-Attribution-NonCommercial and must NOT be used as a source if RECONgame is ever sold.

ak._note: The one pack in service before 2026-07-28. Its weapon rides a SECOND armature whose bones are dumped wholesale with a W_ prefix, which is where W_Grip, W_bolt and W_Magazine come from.

bolt_rifle._note: A true bolt cycle: lift, draw, push, turn. Serves mosin and m70, whose clips are currently an AK charging-handle pull standing in for a bolt throw.

shotgun._unit_trap: MEASURED 2026-07-28: this rig's armature carries object scale 11.424 and its world coordinates run in the tens, unlike every other pack, which is true metres. Hands sit ~16.8 units apart where two hands on a shotgun are ~0.35 m, so one unit is roughly 0.021 m. Transferred displacement MUST be converted or every motion lands ~48x too large. Do not assume a pack is metric - measure it.
shotgun._note: Shell-by-shell loading with the shell as its own bone. Serves ithaca, and its shell-handling beats are the middle of the m79 break-action reload.

smg._note: Serves ppsh and thompson. `bolt` is the internal bolt; `charginghandle` is the part a hand actually touches.

break_action._note: Downloaded 2026-07-28 on the Summoner's ruling that the M79 be built from a break-action shotgun. The barrel group `front` carries the hinge rotation and the slugs are extracted and reloaded as separate objects - the only break-open performance found on Sketchfab. Weapon parts are OBJECTS here, not bones.

gun_pack._doc: Which pack supplies each manifest gun. A gun absent from this map still falls back to the AK pack, which is what every gun used before 2026-07-28 - correct only for AK-pattern magazine rifles.

_gaps: No Sketchfab pack exists for a belt-fed feed-tray reload (m60) or for a shoulder-launched rocket beyond RPG-7 Animations by TheParaziT, which is downloadable and not yet ingested. m60, m72_law, rpg2 and rpg7 therefore still run AK-pattern clips.
